definitions.explanation: A device used to close or seal an opening — a bottle cap, cork, drain plug, faucet, or any kind of stopper.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボトル→ボトル：11270_botoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{栓|せん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧。
examples.english: Pull the cork from the bottle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風呂|ふろ}→風呂：14633_furo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{栓|せん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}め→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I forgot to put the plug in the bathtub.

examples.japanese: ⟦{消火栓|しょうかせん}→消火栓：29794_shoukasen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駐車|ちゅうしゃ}しない→駐車する：22431_chuushasuru⟧で⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please do not park in front of the fire hydrant.

notes:
A general word for any kind of stopper, plug, cork, or tap that seals or controls flow through an opening.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {栓|せん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧ — to pull a cork/plug
- {栓|せん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧ — to close a plug/stopper
- {栓|せん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to plug, to cork
- {栓|せん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧ — to open a tap/valve

- ⟦{栓抜|せんぬ}き→栓抜き：07010_sennuki⟧ — bottle opener, corkscrew

- ⟦{水栓|すいせん}→水栓：22083_suisen⟧ — faucet, water tap
- ⟦{蛇口|じゃぐち}→蛇口：04218_jaguchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{栓|せん} — faucet tap
